STOP.

PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS BELOW BEFORE CONTINUING TO CREATE YOUR CHARACTER.


Hi! I see you've come to make your own NEALYAJAYMAY styled Character.
Here are some things that you should remember. (Make sure you are following the Community Guidelines when you create your character.)

1: It doesn't matter what hair style, species or build you use for this character, as long as you have a darker version of that character's hair, skin and body/clothing colors, you're good to go.

2. You can add any other parts to your character, even if it is from one of your other characters you own/created. Just make sure it's appropriate. (Smaller parts make it easier to add to the character and color up.

3. Make sure you change the color of all of the eyes of the emotion costume as well as those of the character themselves, to prevent color confusion. (Unless your character has rainbow eyes, like Rainbow Reya)

4. Don't forget to credit me when you use the character style for your character(s). ("Credit to all" and "Credit to @ajaymay for the character base that NAMEOFYOURCHARACTER used." is also acceptable.)
